maintenance_signal.boundary: activity/adoption metadata only; no health or production claim

dependency_sbom.boundary: No dependency, security, license, or SBOM inspection was performed.

reference_only_boundary.reason: Reference-only until a future authorized clean-room gate establishes pinned identity, rights/provenance, dependency/SBOM, bounded inspection, and falsifier evidence. Matrix presence is not capability proof.

falsifier: A pinned clean-room inspection falsifies the candidate if the documented prompt-to-artifact or agent boundary is absent, credential-dependent without disclosure, or unsupported by the allowed evidence paths.
next_clean_room_gate: Obtain an immutable commit/tag and re-check repository identity.
Review LICENSE/NOTICE, contributor/owner provenance, and attribution obligations.
Inspect only an allowlisted README, manifest, dependency-lock, and top-level path set in an isolated clean room; do not copy code.
Generate a dependency/SBOM record and classify transitive rights, secrets, and runtime requirements.
Capture a falsifier result and stop before any build, execution, deployment, extraction, or admission.

retention_and_correction.correction_route: Append a linked correction receipt identifying the source record, changed field, observer, and date; do not silently overwrite.
